About the Practice

Catholic Health is a non-profit healthcare system based in Buffalo, NY, serving Western New York with a network of over 75 locations, including hospitals, medical offices, nursing homes, home care agencies, and other community-based ministries. The system provides comprehensive care across a wide range of specialties, such as acute care, emergency care, critical care, primary care, specialty care, continuing care, home care, rehabilitation, senior care, cardiac care, general surgery, neuro/stroke care, orthopedics, vascular care, and women's care, including recognized maternity services. Rooted in Catholic values, Catholic Health is committed to providing high-quality, compassionate, and patient-centered care with dignity and respect throughout all stages of health and wellness.

Research Analysis
Methodology & Findings
